source: LA Recreation & Parks pickleball list (laparks.org/pickleball), read 16 November 2026
notes: hybrid = a tennis court with pickleball lines painted on it; dedicated = pickleball only.

Coordinates are the courts themselves, not the postal address: three sites are marked correction because their published address geocoded 1.5-4 km away, and for those the coordinates come from the OSM courts or park the city means.
OSM wins: a venue that already carries an explicit OSM pickleball count is never changed by this file.

sites.name: Westchester Courts
sites.note: correction: the address geocodes 4 km away in South Central; these are the Westchester Park tennis courts (way/22729526)

sites.name: Peck Park Community Center
sites.note: correction: the street address geocodes 3 km north; these are the Peck Park tennis courts (way/136641845)

sites.name: Chatsworth Recreation Center
sites.note: the list counts 2 dedicated + 2 hybrid here; the overlay carries the total. Deliberately left at OSM's count: Chatsworth Park South already carries an explicit pickleball count from OSM (1), and the rule is that a mapped court beats a list. Its notebook entry stays as a reminder that the city says 4; change the rule, not this row, if the list should win.

sites.name: Park Center, Griffith Park
sites.note: correction: the published address geocodes to Griffith Park Boys Camp, 1.5 km west of the courts and far enough away that the site became a second pin. These coordinates are the four tennis courts themselves (way/1491866543), so the site merges into that venue instead of adding a pin on the wrong hillside.
